verdict.rationale: Proton Pass advertises secure vault sharing, generates TOTP codes for saved logins, and organizes items into vaults, so a team could plausibly share TOTP-enabled logins through a shared vault. The evidence is only a one-line marketing bullet for sharing, with nothing on how sharing works for teams. Missing for 10: documented per-member access control or permission roles on shared vaults, collections or granular item sharing, IT-admin team management controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sharing TOTP items.
